f3_program: collection("james.houses_visited", "house", "james", source("James visits 20 houses"))
observe(at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_1"), 20, "count", source("James visits 20 houses"))
collection("james.houses_with_sales", "house", "james", source("sell something in every house"))
same(at("james.houses_with_sales.count", "day_1"), at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_1"), source("He manages to sell something in every house"))
multiple(at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_2"), at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_1"), 2, source("The next day he visits twice as many houses"))
percent_of(at("james.houses_with_sales.count", "day_2"), at("james.houses_visited.count", "day_2"), 80, source("only sold to 80% of houses"))

member("james.items_sold_by_day", "james.items_sold_by_day.day_1.count", source("each of the two days"))
member("james.items_sold_by_day", "james.items_sold_by_day.day_2.count", source("each of the two days"))
rate_relation(at("james.items_sold_by_day.day_1.count", "two_days"), 2, at("james.houses_with_sales.count", "day_1"), source("sold two things at each house in each of the two days"))
rate_relation(at("james.items_sold_by_day.day_2.count", "two_days"), 2, at("james.houses_with_sales.count", "day_2"), source("sold two things at each house in each of the two days"))
query("sum", "james.items_sold_by_day", "two_days")
